substrate: REAL headless Chrome + REAL built MV3 extension + REAL chrome.storage.session + REAL ServiceWorker.stopWorker eviction
recordedSeparatelyFrom: long_horizon_evidence.json (the existing 7/17.4 journey result is unchanged and not restated here)

steps.action: load unpacked MV3 extension in real Chrome
probe real chrome.storage.session availability inside the real service worker
write the production-serialized record into real chrome.storage.session and read it back
genuinely terminate the MV3 service worker (ServiceWorker.stopWorker)
steps.detail: stopWorker did not fire: {"code":-32601,"message":"'ServiceWorker.enable' wasn't found"}

steps.action: attach to the service worker after the restart and read the record back
validate + restore the surviving record through the production code path

PROVEN_REAL: chrome.storage.session is available to the built extension and round-trips a production-serialized record
the record survives detaching the service-worker debugger and attaching a fresh CDP session
the production validator accepts it and the production restore recovers actionCount, the fingerprint ring and loop detection
NOT_PROVEN: That an MV3 service-worker EVICTION preserves the record. The ServiceWorker CDP domain is not available on the browser-level target in this Chromium build, so ServiceWorker.stopWorker could not be issued and the worker context was never destroyed. The durability of chrome.storage.session across a true worker eviction is therefore demonstrated only by Chrome's documented contract, not by this run.
summary.limitation: The eviction half of the scenario is CONTROLLED at best, not demonstrated. It is recorded as PARTIAL rather than as a real-Chrome restart proof. The focused suite covers the restore/validate/refuse logic against a working store, and M1-M5 prove that logic is load-bearing.
summary.notInflated: This does not restate or alter the existing 7/7 long-horizon journey result in long_horizon_evidence.json.

chromeLifecycleTest: PARTIAL — real Chrome, real extension, real chrome.storage.session; the worker EVICTION was not induced (ServiceWorker CDP domain unavailable on the browser target), so only detach/reattach durability is demonstrated.
